d: An anthropomorphic squirrel with thick, fluffy chocolate-brown fur and a large, bushy tail featuring reddish-orange tips. The face is expressive with a wide, toothy smile and small, dark, glistening eyes. This creature has a small, stout build and wears a cream-colored aviator cap with fleece lining, silver-rimmed goggles perched on top, and a tattered, sleeveless rust-orange tunic decorated with small circular badges. Accessories include a green handheld electronic device and a long, braided rope with red and white patterns draped across the body. BODY COLOR: chocolate-brown
